config.description: When a finished task's worker (its Kubernetes Job or Tekton TaskRun) is removed. A task's logs are read from its worker, so they go with it, and a run's storage is only freed once no worker still holds it. Always: at task end. On Success: at task end if the task succeeded; a failed task's worker stays for its logs. Never: not at task end; the worker, its logs and any storage it holds stay until the retention period (kube.task.ttlDays, 7 days by default) removes it.
config.label: Deletion Policy
